meta.name: alien_invasion_farm
meta.prompt: A small farm town being invaded by aliens.

programs.brief: A menacing biomechanical alien mothership hovering low over the town square, dark chitin carapace plating with pulsing cyan energy seams and downward-aimed beam conduits.
A metallic disc scout saucer embedded nose-down into the furrowed earth, cracked hull panels venting faint plasma glow with exposed conduit wiring.
A jagged alien assault drop pod punched into the soil at an angle, open hatch facing outward with an illuminated bioluminescent interior core.

tokens.event_direction: alien invasion forces and hovering craft descending from above the rural fields into the farm town
tokens.infra: crop_circle over the outer crop fields; barricade_line across the main road into town; quarantine_fence ringing the north farmstead
tokens.icons: alien landing pods amidst the wheat fields; damaged silos and tractor tracks; beam scorches across the barn roofs
